directions.title: Six directions, one university
directions.subtitle: Every part of student life at Amanzholov University connects back to these six pillars.

items.title: Education
items.description: Bachelor's, master's and doctoral programs built with employers and reviewed every year.

items.title: Science
items.description: Research labs and grant-funded projects spanning natural, technical and social sciences.

items.title: Innovation
items.description: Startup incubation, technology transfer and an applied approach to solving real problems.

items.title: International cooperation
items.description: Exchange semesters, joint degrees and research with partner universities across the world.

items.title: Student life
items.description: Clubs, sport, volunteering and self-government that make campus feel like home.

items.title: Career
items.description: Internships, employer partnerships and a career center that opens doors before graduation.

items.title: New biotechnology laboratory opens on campus
items.excerpt: The lab gives students hands-on access to equipment used in genomics and applied microbiology research, funded through a national science grant.

items.title: Double-degree agreement signed with three European universities
items.excerpt: Students in engineering and economics can now graduate with two diplomas through a redesigned exchange track starting this fall.

items.title: Admission committee opens for the 2026/2027 intake
items.excerpt: Applications for bachelor's and master's programs are now open, with new scholarship tiers for high Unified National Testing scores.

items.title: Robotics team wins regional engineering olympiad
items.excerpt: A team of four undergraduate students took first place with an autonomous navigation project mentored by the Faculty of Engineering.
